note: Both sets capture the main panel, NFDS, and wiring-schedule entries, but Set A introduces fabricated item-20 specs ("3#10, 1#12G" where the schedule reads 3#12, #12G.), misreads 3#4/0 as "3440" in two claims, and misbinds the 2-1/2" conduit size as a cable "diameter". Set B keeps the schedule rows (10, 31, 32, 33, 34, 50, 150, 151) correctly bound with supporting quotes and adds the 4 AWG copper-to-ground and current-sensor connections. Set B's errors are the invented Cable 24 entry, a fabricated Cable 50 spec ("3WB, #10" instead of 3#6, #8G.), and the same "3440" misread, plus a truncated "TO UTILI" quote. Overall Set B has fewer wrong and better-bound claims, though both contain trivial identifier claims.
